name: coordination-hooks
description: Fleet coordination hooks: knowledge-base-first, check-your-messages and role-binding reminders; idle-wake and git-mutation guard; heartbeat report-alive, rotation-due watch, and rotation-due notice; memory-passthrough capture, session context, drain, hydrate, index and sync utilities; spawn-injected worker hooks; and owner-qualified receipt guards for heartbeat, rotation-due, and wake effects.
